desktop.notesZh:
批次九（质量监控三卡重构 + 指令集流程图 + 工作流图配置入口）
① 工作流·质量监控重构为三卡——环境：六项工具链真机版本探测（GCC/Ruby/Ceedling/gcovr/cpplint/Cppcheck，必装/选装 + 已就绪/未安装徽章）、当前工作区支持判定、一键安装（初始化 gem/pip 工具链并回写质量资产，附分步结果）；配置：单元测试目录/报告目录/构建目录、行覆盖率阈值、测试报告（存在性探测 + HTML 模态框预览 + 打开文件，标注取值来源 内置默认/工作区）；规范：单元测试相关规范文档按 测试纪律/静态分析/环境搭建/配置模板 四组分类展示（10 条，点击全屏模态看全文）；旧「单元测试（Ceedling · Unity · CMock）」卡与「baf-quality · 质量门禁」卡删除
② 工作流新增「指令集」页签（确认门与企业规范之间）：企业规范同款完整流程图（8 节点 + SVG 箭头 + 图例），每个状态节点 accent 标注该状态支持的 baf 指令条数，点击节点下方列全部指令卡——命令名/一句话用途/完整解释（做什么用、有什么效果），默认展示接单节点
③ 会话·工作流图顶部新增「配置」按钮：一键直达工作流配置页（通用 tab）
desktop.notesEn:
Batch nine (quality tab three-card rebuild + commands flowchart + workflow-graph config entry)
(1) Workflow > quality rebuilt as three cards - Environment: live version probes for the six toolchain members (GCC/Ruby/Ceedling/gcovr/cpplint/Cppcheck with required/optional tags and ready/missing badges), a support verdict for the current workspace, and one-click install (gem/pip members initialized + quality assets written, with a step report); Configuration: unit-test/report/build directories, line-coverage threshold, test report (existence probe + HTML modal preview + open file, value source labeled builtin-default/workspace); Standards: unit-test docs grouped into test discipline / static analysis / environment setup / config templates (ten entries, click for the fullscreen modal); the old unit-test (Ceedling · Unity · CMock) card and the baf-quality gate card are gone
(2) A new Commands tab (between gates and enterprise standards): a full flowchart in the enterprise-standards style (8 nodes + SVG arrows + legend); every state node accents its supported baf command count, clicking a node lists all its command cards - command name / one-line purpose / full explanation of what it does and its effect; the intake node shows by default
(3) The session workflow-graph strip gains a Config button that jumps straight to the workflow configuration page (general tab)
